claims: Remontada is a Spanish term meaning "comeback" or "turnaround".
Remontada is derived from the Spanish remontar.
Remontar means to climb again, to lift, or to overcome.
Remontada gained worldwide fame after FC Barcelona overturned a 4-0 first-leg loss against Paris Saint-Germain.
FC Barcelona won 6-1 at home against Paris Saint-Germain in the 2016–17 UEFA Champions League round of 16.
Remontada is phonetically spelled as /rreh-mon-tah-dah/ or /re.mon.ta.ða/.
